result.summary: Several layout and content clipping issues are visible: restaurant names and category chips are truncated, and a promo card is cut off at the bottom of the screen.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated with missing letters in the Fastest near you row.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line names, reduce font size, or ensure cards and text containers expand/ellipsis consistently so full names remain readable.

issues.description: The bottom pizza promo card is heavily clipped by the bottom navigation, hiding most of the image and any title or details below it.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding/scroll inset so content clears the tab bar, and ensure the last card can fully enter the viewport.

issues.description: Category filter chips overflow horizontally; the rightmost chip is cut off mid-control with no clear affordance that the row scrolls.
issues.suggestion: Add fade/peek of the next chip, padding at the end of the scroll area, or a clearer horizontal scroll indicator.

issues.description: Search placeholder text appears to misspell 'Restaurants' as 'Restarants'.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder copy to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.
